exposure: Category II intrapartum fetal heart rate tracing
cohort: 248 pregnant women with gestational age 35-42 weeks and category II intrapartum fetal heart rate tracing at Songklanagarind Hospital.
finding: Maternal infection, thick meconium stained amniotic fluid, and moderate to severe late decelerations were independently associated with adverse neonatal outcomes in the setting of category II intrapartum fetal heart rate tracing.
